authority.note: This inventory is authored from the committed normative contract and frozen implementation. It does not claim that a hidden pre-existing 59-item inventory existed.

visible_surfaces: account-scoped workspace persistence, migration, service, API, and global catalog
runtime workspace resolution, external-path permission gating, and containment
typed V3 workspace grants, usage projection, discovery, hydration, and realtime
managed-worktree branch capture, integration revalidation, and cleanup
TUI and Desktop workspace-scope permission wording
Desktop workspace catalog, editor, activity, and observational Workspaces in use state

workspace_policy_choices.outcome: An account-owned saved workspace is globally discoverable and its canonical primary path is workspace-authorized without a workspace-scope prompt; unrelated operation policy still applies.
A path outside all authorized roots requires explicit session-only workspace-scope approval; approval creates a typed temporary grant and never persists linked membership.

operation_policy_outcomes.not_exercised: The scenario observes metadata, storage, UI, or lifecycle state and does not authorize an executable operation.
operation_policy_outcomes.evaluate_independently: After workspace authorization is resolved, the tool's ordinary operation policy is evaluated unchanged; workspace authorization is neither approval nor denial of that operation.
operation_policy_outcomes.must_remain_gated: Workspace authorization may succeed, but the named Bash, Git, task, deploy, or destructive operation must remain pending or denied until its own policy permits execution.
operation_policy_outcomes.no_operation_after_workspace_denial: Workspace denial or cancellation prevents execution and state mutation; no operation-policy result may be fabricated as success.

lanes.A: Persistence, API, migration, global catalog, stable identity, and account isolation
lanes.B: Runtime resolution, normal workspace permission behavior, and external-path grants
lanes.C: Desktop presentation plus V3 discovery, hydration, reconnect, and realtime
lanes.D: Checked-in deterministic E2E diagnostic for all 59 cases and branch/worktree behavior
lanes.E: Adversarial, fault-injection, denial, race, containment, and zero-side-effect behavior

requirements.outcome: AUTO_MANAGE and REQUIRE are distinct frozen workspace-policy outcomes.
AUTO_MANAGE authorizes only the canonical path of an account-owned saved workspace without a workspace-scope prompt.
REQUIRE escalates an external path to explicit session-only approval and never creates persistent linked authority.
The account-global workspace catalog is complete, deterministic, paginated, and not limited to the current workspace.
Saved workspace metadata is visible without a workspace-scope prompt; discovery is not filesystem-operation authorization.
Approved external paths become typed temporary grants for the current session only via the canonical V3 mutation boundary.
Denied or cancelled external-path requests execute nothing and mutate neither workspace catalog nor session grants.
Every path-bearing argument, including batched paths and nested launch workspace paths, is checked before execution.
Workspace membership authority is flat: one saved entry owns exactly one canonical primary path.
Historical linked directories migrate once into deterministic independent account-scoped workspace entries without duplicates.
Add To Workspace and linked-folder UX are absent; compatibility add/remove routes create/delete independent workspaces rather than links.
Workspace authorization and operation authorization are separate decisions with separate evidence.
Bash and Git policy cannot be bypassed by AUTO_MANAGE or a temporary workspace grant.
Task launch, session deploy, and destructive-operation policy cannot be bypassed by workspace authorization.
Delegation captures the actually checked-out source branch and exact HEAD; it never infers an integration branch.
Managed child work never switches the source checkout branch or writes into its working tree.
Detached-HEAD and non-Git sources fail clearly when a captured branch is required; no default branch fallback is used.
Integration revalidates both captured parent branch and exact parent HEAD immediately before applying the child stack.
Only committed descendant child lineage is integrated; batch preflight is ordered and failure rolls the whole batch back.
Cleanup removes only a clean private managed child whose immutable commit range is represented in the parent.
Dirty, unresolved, conflicting, or unintegrated child work remains recallable and is never erased or auto-committed.
Workspace catalog, identity, policy, grants, and discovery are isolated by authenticated account scope.
Principal-less legacy mutations fail closed and cannot become a fallback authority.
Workspace identity is stable and carries a positive generation through bindings, grants, and projections.
A session with a stale captured workspace ID or generation fails before tool execution.
Canonical path containment is symlink-aware and revalidated; lexical containment alone is insufficient.
Filesystem root is never admitted as a workspace-scope expansion.
New temporary grants cross ApplySessionMutation atomically with event, projection, idempotency, and realtime outbox state.
Primary, worktree, and temporary grants are normalized, deduplicated, ordered, and durable.
Workspace usage is path-free identity metadata; anonymous temporary paths are excluded from the global usage index.
Discovery, hydration, reconnect, and realtime expose consistent grant and usage state without a client-side authority fork.
Historical or unavailable workspace identities remain recognizable with explicit availability rather than disappearing or granting access.
Workspace settings preserve the two policy choices while external-path permission UI offers only session access or denial.
Workspaces in use is observational projection state and never becomes client-side authorization authority.

scenarios.title: Save one flat workspace
scenarios.observable_outcome: Saving a canonical directory creates one account-scoped workspace with a stable ID, positive generation, and directories equal only to its primary path.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: The saved primary path is eligible for AUTO_MANAGE in its owning account.

scenarios.title: List complete global catalog
scenarios.observable_outcome: Walking every overview page returns every saved workspace exactly once in deterministic order, including entries beyond the first page.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Metadata listing does not grant filesystem access to any returned path.

scenarios.title: Update flat workspace metadata
scenarios.observable_outcome: Rename and theme updates preserve workspace ID, generation semantics, primary path, and flat directories.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Authorization remains bound to the unchanged canonical primary path.

scenarios.title: Delete independent workspace
scenarios.observable_outcome: Explicit deletion removes only the selected independent workspace and does not unlink or mutate another entry.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: The deleted path is no longer AUTO_MANAGE-authorized unless separately saved or session-granted.

scenarios.title: Preserve catalog across restart
scenarios.observable_outcome: After store/service restart, the same catalog entries, IDs, generations, ordering, and current binding are returned.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Restart does not broaden or erase saved workspace authority.

scenarios.title: Migrate historical linked directories
scenarios.observable_outcome: Each historical secondary directory becomes an independent account-scoped workspace; the parent normalizes to its primary path only.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Each migrated path is authorized only through its own new flat entry.

scenarios.title: Retry migration without duplicates
scenarios.observable_outcome: Repeated and partially completed migration produces the same deterministic IDs and no duplicate paths or entries.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Retry never grants a path more broadly than its independent entry.

scenarios.title: Compatibility add creates flat workspace
scenarios.observable_outcome: The compatibility directory-add route creates a normal independent workspace and local self binding; it does not append parent membership.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Only the new workspace primary path becomes AUTO_MANAGE-authorized.

scenarios.title: Compatibility remove deletes flat workspace
scenarios.observable_outcome: The compatibility directory-remove route explicitly deletes the independent target workspace and leaves the parent unchanged.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Deleted target authority disappears; parent authority does not change.

scenarios.title: Keep source media outside generic scope
scenarios.observable_outcome: Registering a source-media directory changes only source-media metadata and never workspace directories or generic filesystem roots.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Generic read/write still requires saved-workspace or session-grant authority.

scenarios.title: Isolate workspace catalogs by account
scenarios.observable_outcome: Two accounts using the same canonical path receive isolated entries, IDs, policies, and lists; neither can fetch or mutate the other's record.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: A path saved by account A does not authorize account B.

scenarios.title: Reject principal-less legacy mutation
scenarios.observable_outcome: Legacy global add, save, rename, theme, current, and linked-directory mutations return a principal-required or disabled-authority error with no state change.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: No fallback workspace authority is created.

scenarios.title: Preserve stable workspace binding identity
scenarios.observable_outcome: Current and topology bindings carry the owning workspace ID and generation and resolve back to the same account-scoped entry.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Only a matching account, ID, generation, and canonical path resolve as saved authority.

scenarios.title: AUTO_MANAGE saved read
scenarios.observable_outcome: A read under a saved workspace primary path proceeds without a workspace-scope permission request.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: AUTO_MANAGE authorizes the canonical saved root.

scenarios.title: AUTO_MANAGE saved write
scenarios.observable_outcome: A write under a saved workspace primary path needs no workspace-scope prompt, while normal write/tool policy remains effective.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: AUTO_MANAGE authorizes only the saved root.

scenarios.title: REQUIRE external read prompt
scenarios.observable_outcome: The first read outside every authorized root emits one typed workspace_scope request identifying requested, resolved, and directory paths.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Execution waits for explicit session-only approval.

scenarios.title: Reuse approved session grant
scenarios.observable_outcome: After session approval, a second access inside the granted directory runs without a second workspace-scope prompt in that session.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: The temporary grant applies only to the approving session and normalized directory.

scenarios.title: Grant external write for session
scenarios.observable_outcome: Approved external write records a temporary grant, executes only after approval, and does not alter the saved catalog.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Session grant authorizes the external directory only for this session.

scenarios.title: Deny external path with zero mutation
scenarios.observable_outcome: Denial returns a denied result, performs no tool effect, and leaves catalog, grants, projection, events, and outbox unchanged except the permission decision record.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: External path remains unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Cancel external path with zero mutation
scenarios.observable_outcome: Cancellation returns a cancelled result, performs no tool effect, and creates no workspace grant or persistent workspace state.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: External path remains unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Inspect every batched path
scenarios.observable_outcome: A call whose first path is inside scope and later path is external still pauses on the external path before any access occurs.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Each path is independently contained or granted; first-path success cannot cover later paths.

scenarios.title: Inspect nested task workspace paths
scenarios.observable_outcome: Top-level and every nested launch workspace_path are inspected; any external target requires workspace approval before launch authorization.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Each target workspace must be account-owned or session-granted.

scenarios.title: Inspect webdownload output directory
scenarios.observable_outcome: An external output_dir triggers workspace-scope resolution before downloaded bytes can be written.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Output directory requires saved or session-granted authority.

scenarios.title: Refuse filesystem-root expansion
scenarios.observable_outcome: A request resolving to the filesystem root fails closed and no root grant or workspace entry is created.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Filesystem root is never authorizable through scope expansion.

scenarios.title: Detect symlink escape
scenarios.observable_outcome: A lexical child path resolving through a symlink outside the root is treated as external and prompts or denies before access.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Canonical resolved target, not lexical prefix, controls workspace authorization.

scenarios.title: Reject symlink replacement race
scenarios.observable_outcome: Replacing a previously validated stored directory or target with a symlink causes revalidation failure and zero tool mutation.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Stale canonical identity is rejected rather than silently followed.

scenarios.title: Reject stale workspace ID
scenarios.observable_outcome: A session whose captured workspace ID differs from the current path's ID fails before resolving tool scope.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Path equality cannot override an ID mismatch.

scenarios.title: Reject stale workspace generation
scenarios.observable_outcome: A session whose captured generation differs from the current workspace generation fails before tool execution.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Stale generation never inherits current workspace authority.

scenarios.title: Deny cross-account runtime scope
scenarios.observable_outcome: A principal from another account cannot resolve, grant, discover, or execute through the target account's workspace identity.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Only authenticated owning-account records are authoritative.

scenarios.title: Honor policy changes between calls
scenarios.observable_outcome: Changing workspace policy or operation policy between two calls changes only the corresponding second-call decision; no stale cached decision leaks across authorities.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: The latest workspace policy controls workspace scope only.

scenarios.title: Keep Bash policy separate
scenarios.observable_outcome: An AUTO_MANAGE or session-granted path does not auto-approve Bash; Bash executes only after its own policy allows it.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace path may be authorized independently.

scenarios.title: Keep Git policy separate
scenarios.observable_outcome: Workspace authorization does not permit commit, cherry-pick, reset, merge, or other Git mutation without the canonical Git permission path.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace scope may permit repository access only.

scenarios.title: Keep task launch policy separate
scenarios.observable_outcome: An authorized target workspace does not launch a subagent until task-launch approval and capacity policy succeed.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Target workspace authorization is necessary but insufficient.

scenarios.title: Keep deploy policy separate
scenarios.observable_outcome: An authorized workspace does not deploy a durable session without fresh deploy approval, including under permission bypass.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace scope does not imply deploy approval.

scenarios.title: Keep destructive policy separate
scenarios.observable_outcome: Delete/destructive operations remain explicitly classified and gated; AUTO_MANAGE cannot downgrade their consequence or criticality.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace authorization does not authorize destructive effect.

scenarios.title: Render two workspace-policy choices
scenarios.observable_outcome: Workspace settings present the frozen AUTO_MANAGE and REQUIRE choices with distinct descriptions and persist the selected value.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Rendered selection reflects server-authoritative policy and is not local-only state.

scenarios.title: Remove linked-folder UX
scenarios.observable_outcome: Desktop create/edit, mobile explorer, and permission surfaces contain no linked-folder picker, Add linked folder, or Add To Workspace action.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: UI cannot create persistent linked scope.

scenarios.title: Offer session-only external approval
scenarios.observable_outcome: Desktop and TUI external-path permission present Allow This Session and Deny only; legacy workspace_add_dir reasons normalize to session_allow.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Approval is temporary and session-scoped.

scenarios.title: Display full global workspace catalog
scenarios.observable_outcome: Desktop follows overview cursors and renders all saved workspaces rather than truncating at one page or current roots.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Catalog display is metadata visibility, not per-path operation approval.

scenarios.title: Show A B C metadata without prompt
scenarios.observable_outcome: The A/B/C demonstration shows recognizable saved-workspace metadata before any filesystem action and without a workspace-scope prompt.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Only saved canonical roots are AUTO_MANAGE-authorized; visibility alone grants nothing.

scenarios.title: Keep Workspaces in use observational
scenarios.observable_outcome: Workspaces in use is derived from server workspace_usage and never mutates grants or decides client-side authorization.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Server grants and resolver remain the sole authority.

scenarios.title: Hydrate typed workspace grants
scenarios.observable_outcome: Hydration returns normalized primary, worktree, and temporary grants in deterministic order after a session grant mutation.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Hydrated grants reflect durable server state and session scope.

scenarios.title: Project path-free workspace usage
scenarios.observable_outcome: workspace_usage includes stable identity, generation, kind, name, and availability but no path; anonymous temporary grants are omitted.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Usage projection cannot be replayed as a filesystem grant.

scenarios.title: Deliver workspace grant realtime update
scenarios.observable_outcome: Approving a temporary grant commits one canonical event/outbox update and realtime membership carries matching grants and usage.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Only the committed session grant changes workspace scope.

scenarios.title: Reconnect without authority fork
scenarios.observable_outcome: After missed delivery or cursor repair, bootstrap/hydration and realtime converge on identical grants and usage; duplicate events do not duplicate projection entries.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Client cache never becomes a second authorization authority.

scenarios.title: Present unavailable historical workspace
scenarios.observable_outcome: A deleted or unavailable historical workspace remains recognizable by identity/name with available=false or unknown, while its path is not exposed through usage.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Historical identity does not authorize current filesystem access.

scenarios.title: Capture and return to fixed dev branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: Starting on a fixed dev branch captures dev and its exact HEAD, runs children in managed worktrees, and integrates back to that unchanged branch without switching the source checkout.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Captured repository must already be workspace-authorized.

scenarios.title: Capture and return to fixed main branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: Starting on a fixed main branch captures main rather than substituting dev and integrates only after branch/HEAD revalidation.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Captured repository authority is unchanged by branch name.

scenarios.title: Capture and return to fixed trunk branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: Starting on trunk captures trunk exactly and never rewrites the target to main or dev.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Captured repository authority is unchanged by branch name.

scenarios.title: Capture manually selected feature branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: A manually selected feature branch is the integration target; default-branch metadata is ignored and the source checkout never switches.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Feature-branch repository remains within the captured workspace scope.

scenarios.title: Capture ordinary nonstandard default branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: A repository whose ordinary default branch has a nonstandard name integrates to the actually checked-out branch, not a hard-coded list.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Branch naming does not alter workspace authorization.

scenarios.title: Reject detached HEAD when branch required
scenarios.observable_outcome: A detached source HEAD fails clearly before child allocation or integration; no branch is guessed and existing work is preserved.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Repository may be in scope, but branch capture is independently invalid.

scenarios.title: Reject non-Git integration source
scenarios.observable_outcome: A non-Git workspace returns a clear repository/branch capture error before managed Coder allocation or integration and leaves files unchanged.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace authorization does not manufacture Git authority.

scenarios.title: Reject dirty captured parent
scenarios.observable_outcome: A dirty source worktree fails before allocation/integration; user changes remain untouched and visible.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace authorization does not permit overwriting dirty work.

scenarios.title: Reject source branch movement during run
scenarios.observable_outcome: If the source branch changes after capture, integration fails with expected/found branch evidence; no child commit is applied or discarded.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace remains in scope but captured branch identity is stale.

scenarios.title: Reject source HEAD movement during run
scenarios.observable_outcome: If source HEAD changes after capture, integration fails with expected/found HEAD evidence and leaves parent plus children unchanged.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Workspace remains in scope but captured commit identity is stale.

scenarios.title: Keep child branch isolated from source checkout
scenarios.observable_outcome: Each child uses a unique sibling managed worktree and branch from the immutable captured base; source branch and working tree remain unchanged until explicit integration.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Child workspace must resolve through authorized managed lineage, not arbitrary paths.

scenarios.title: Integrate committed child stack to captured branch
scenarios.observable_outcome: Committed descendant child commits preflight in order, apply atomically to the captured branch, produce a verified resulting HEAD, and only then permit safe cleanup.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Integration parent and every child are authenticated managed workspace lineage.

scenarios.title: Forbid legacy default-branch inference
scenarios.observable_outcome: Legacy assumptions about main, master, trunk, dev, remote HEAD, or stored default branch never override the actually captured branch; absent capture fails closed.
scenarios.workspace_authorization_expected: Legacy workspace or branch metadata is not current authorization authority.

attack_points: Treating WorkspaceEntry.directories or historical linked paths as current membership authority
Checking only the first path or first nested task launch workspace_path
Accepting legacy workspace_add_dir permission reasons as persistent authority
Writing temporary roots outside ApplySessionMutation and losing event/projection/outbox atomicity
Ignoring captured workspace ID or generation mismatches when paths still match
Using lexical prefix containment or failing to revalidate symlinks at execution time
Letting workspace approval short-circuit Bash, Git, task, deploy, or destructive-operation policy
Truncating the account-global catalog at one overview page or current-root filter
Leaking raw temporary paths through workspace_usage or treating usage as authority
Inferring, checking out, or switching to a conventional default branch
Revalidating only parent HEAD while ignoring captured parent branch
Partially applying a child stack without full rollback and preserved lineage
Cleaning dirty, unresolved, conflicting, or unintegrated child work
Duplicating grants through replayed events, outbox repair, or hydration mismatch
Resolving workspace authority by path without authenticated account ownership
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not weaken, merge, delete, skip, quarantine, or rename scenarios to make the count or suite pass.
Do not substitute mock-only coverage for workspace store, resolver, permission, V3 mutation, Git integration, or realtime production paths.
Do not let a test agent modify production code or reinterpret this manifest.
Do not treat scenario count, coverage percentage, snapshots, retries, or sleeps as semantic proof.
Do not add persistent linked-directory authority or restore Add To Workspace UX.
Do not conflate workspace authorization with operation-policy approval.
Do not assume main, master, trunk, dev, remote HEAD, or configured default is the captured integration branch.
Do not switch the source checkout, hide dirty state, auto-commit blocked work, or remove unresolved managed worktrees.
Do not expose private paths in path-free usage projections or sanitized evidence.
Do not claim success if IDs, semantic keys, lane mappings, special-case count, or manifest digest differ from this freeze.
